about_the_game:
GOALS isn’t just about playing—it’s about mastering the game. Climb the ranks, score with style, and rise above the competition. To be the best, play the best.

GOALS is redefining football games by creating a fast-paced, skill-driven experience where players are in full control of their playstyle and destiny. Designed for everyone ready to step up, it’s accessible on any platform and welcomes both newcomers and seasoned players alike. By building a fair, competitive ecosystem where effort and mastery are rewarded, GOALS inspires players to rise to the top and define the next era of football esports.

Develop your club, build your squad, and evolve together on the field. Every player is unique in both attributes and appearance. Expect a responsive gameplay experience designed to actually feel like football. GOALS is easy to learn, but nearly impossible to fully master.

GOALS is free to play*. Play matches to earn currency, to use in store to generate players. Get new kits and celebrations. Keep the best players in your squad, and exchange the ones you don’t want with Swaps. See your players progress and eventually retire to become club legends. You will also see some of your favorite real life footballers and celebrities featured in GOALS.

*Applicable platform account and subscription (sold separately) may be required. This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire in-game items, including random selections of in-game items.

GOALS will be playable on Windows, Playstation and Xbox. The Alpha is currently on Windows and Xbox Series X only.

Immerse yourself in the exhilarating 1v1 online mode or join forces with friends in the forthcoming 5v5 game mode. GOALS’ Simulation Engine Technology (SENTEC) minimizes input delay to ensure an optimal gaming experience.

Aspire to greatness in GOALS' competitive modes, where you can climb the top 500 leaderboard in Ranked or tackle weekly tournaments. Take part in official esports tournaments with prize money.

JOIN OUR COMMUNITY

Share your feedback and engage in the discussions at the GOALS Discord

GOALS is still under development. The full game might have elements and assets absent in the alpha.
